description:
## Context

`OctoPi.TUI.Clipboard` (`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/clipboard.ex`) is fully implemented with:
- `copy/2` — OSC 52 + native clipboard (pbcopy/wl-copy/xclip/xsel)
- `osc52/1`, `extract_code_blocks/1`, `platform_command/0`, `try_native/1`

`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/keybindings.ex` (~line 80) defines `"app.clipboard.pasteImage"` as a keybinding action, but no `dispatch_app_action` clause handles it in `interactive.ex`.

This ticket **depends on the Terminal.Image ticket** — `render_image/3`, `get_image_dimensions/2`, and `Renderer.get_cell_dims/1` must exist.

Upstream reference: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/utils/clipboard.ts` and `clipboard-image.ts`

## Implementation steps

### 1. Read Interactive before modifying

Read `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex`. Find:
- `dispatch_app_action/3` and its existing clauses
- How transcript/input is appended to
- Any existing copy-message handling (search: "copy", "Clipboard")

### 2. Add paste_image_from_clipboard/0 to Clipboard module

`apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/clipboard.ex`:

```elixir
@spec paste_image_from_clipboard() :: {:ok, %{data: binary(), mime_type: String.t()}} | :error
def paste_image_from_clipboard() do
  case :os.type() do
    {:unix, :darwin} -> paste_macos()
    {:unix, _} -> paste_linux()
    _ -> :error
  end
end
```

For macOS, use `System.cmd("osascript", ["-e", "..."])` or `pngpaste -` to read PNG clipboard data.
For Linux, try `wl-paste --type image/png` (Wayland) then `xclip -selection clipboard -t image/png -o` (X11).

Return `{:ok, %{data: base64_data, mime_type: "image/png"}}` on success, `:error` otherwise.

See `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/utils/clipboard-image.ts` for the upstream platform implementations to port.

### 3. Add dispatch clause in interactive.ex

```elixir
defp dispatch_app_action("app.clipboard.pasteImage", state, _key) do
  case Clipboard.paste_image_from_clipboard() do
    {:ok, %{data: base64_data, mime_type: mime_type}} ->
      image_dims =
        case Image.get_image_dimensions(base64_data, mime_type) do
          {:ok, dims} -> dims
          :error -> %{width: 100, height: 100}
        end
      cell_dims = Renderer.get_cell_dims(state.renderer_pid)
      case Image.render_image(base64_data, image_dims, cell_dims: cell_dims, mime_type: mime_type) do
        {:ok, encoded, _rows} -> append_to_input(state, encoded)
        {:fallback, text} -> append_to_input(state, text)
      end
    :error ->
      state
  end
end
```

### 4. Wire copy-to-clipboard for assistant messages (if not already present)

Search for copy-related app actions. If `"app.copy"` or similar is undefined, add:
```elixir
defp dispatch_app_action("app.copy", state, _key) do
  last = get_last_assistant_message_text(state)
  if last, do: Clipboard.copy(last)
  state
end
```

### 5. Tests

- `Clipboard.copy/2` with `write_osc: false` returns `{:ok, osc52_string}` without IO side effect
- `paste_image_from_clipboard/0` on unsupported platform returns `:error` (no raise)
- `paste_image_from_clipboard/0` mocked on macOS returns `{:ok, %{data: ..., mime_type: "image/png"}}`
- Interactive: `dispatch_app_action("app.clipboard.pasteImage", ...)` completes without error when paste returns `:error`

## Notes
- `paste_image_from_clipboard/0` is best-effort — on unsupported platforms must return `:error` gracefully.
- `append_to_input/2` — find the correct function name by reading interactive.ex; it may be named differently.
- `state.renderer_pid` — confirm this field name by reading the State struct.
title: Wire OctoPi.TUI.Clipboard into Interactive: image paste handler
